resources.string: Feeds and publishers
Subscribed feeds, preview feeds and redirect targets receive the requested URL path and query, conditional cache headers, and Basic credentials only for the matching origin.
Pages and feed candidates

The page you enter or share, up to five well-known feed paths on that site, and publisher candidates receive their requested URL path and query. Candidates can use other hosts. Neutrodyne verifies up to five candidates; it does not send them to a directory.
Audio hosts
Enclosure hosts and publisher measurement redirects receive the media URL, range requests, and matching-origin credentials when needed. They can measure playback or downloads by IP and User-Agent.
Artwork hosts

Feed and directory artwork hosts, including Apple image CDNs, fyyd image hosts and Podcast Index artwork URLs, receive the requested image path when a cover is displayed. Directory switches do not block images already returned.
Chapter hosts
Hosts referenced by episode chapters receive the chapter-file URL when chapters are loaded.
Show-notes image hosts
Image hosts receive the image URL when images are allowed or you choose to load them. Change this in Feeds settings.
Apple

itunes.apple.com receives search text, country and search parameters; explicit Apple, pod.link or Overcast lookups send Apple podcast IDs. rss.marketingtools.apple.com receives the country for overall charts. Genre charts send country and genre ID to itunes.apple.com; chart resolution sends podcast IDs there. Apple receives no subscriptions, feed URLs or Podcast Index credentials.
fyyd
api.fyyd.de receives search text and result-count parameters. It receives no country, subscriptions, feed URLs or API credentials. A fyyd page entered in Add is fetched as a web page.
Podcast Index

api.podcastindex.org receives search text and result-count parameters, or an explicit Podcast Index feed ID. Every request includes X-Auth-Key (API key), X-Auth-Date (timestamp), and Authorization (SHA-1 of key, secret and timestamp); the secret itself is not sent. Verifying a pair sends the fixed query “podcast”. No country, subscriptions or feed URLs are sent.
YouTube subscriptions

When you add or refresh a YouTube channel, www.youtube.com receives channel IDs and page/feed requests. YouTube thumbnail hosts (i.ytimg.com, yt3.googleusercontent.com, yt3.ggpht.com) receive image paths.
YouTube playback and channel search

With the engine, www.youtube.com receives video/channel IDs, explicit channel searches, locale, client headers and an in-memory consent cookie. googlevideo.com hosts receive media requests. Podcast search text is not sent to YouTube.
YouTube engine updates
When enabled, the project GitHub Pages host receives approved-manifest requests; github.com and release-assets.githubusercontent.com receive engine download paths.
App updates
When enabled, github.com and release-assets.githubusercontent.com receive update-manifest requests with the app User-Agent. Tapping a release or download opens your browser.
Your sync server

Only after linking: your server receives its device token, device name, platform/version and synced library state, including private feed URLs. Feed passwords are shared only when enabled. It receives no audio or feed contents. The server operator can read stored data.
Links you open
Your browser or chosen app receives a link you tap, including release/download links. Its own privacy settings apply.
Issue tracker
Reporting a problem opens github.com in your browser. Review any report before sending it.
Sync server updates
The optional sync server, rather than this app, checks github.com and release-assets.githubusercontent.com for updates when its operator enables the check.
